t: You're looking at Francis Holland School, one of three separate private day schools for girls in central London. They share a name and are run by the Francis Holland Schools Trust. This one is in Westminster, and the schools sit at Clarence Gate and at Graham Terrace. The name comes from Francis James Holland, who lived from 1828 to 1907. He was a canon in the Church of England and a promoter of Anglican schools for girls, which is why his name is on the gate.
